title: Run a shell command
description: Run a shell command in the bound workspace. The run execution world owns its sandbox policy, environment, output bounds, descendants, and teardown.

command.description: The shell command line to run, e.g. "npm test" or "git status".

timeoutMs.description: Optional wall-clock timeout in ms (default 120000, max 600000).

sandbox_permissions.description: Optional one-call request for the narrowest strictly wider sandbox mode required.

justification.description: Why this exact call cannot complete under the current sandbox mode.
